name: Do I need a permit to widen a bathroom doorway in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to widen a bathroom doorway in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in Daly City, as with many other Bay Area municipalities, you typically need a building permit to widen a bathroom doorway, especially if the work involves altering a load-bearing wall or significantly modifying the structural integrity of your home. Permits ensure that the renovation complies with local building codes, safety standards, and zoning regulations. Failing to obtain a necessary permit can lead to fines, difficulties with future home sales, and potential safety hazards. It's always best to consult with your contractor or the Daly City Building Division.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a building permit is generally required in Daly City to widen a bathroom doorway, particularly if it involves structural changes.
